title:
Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine handles queries for unstructured data. For each query, it will use the R(E)A -
Read (Extract) Answer - pipeline to determine similar passages from the {@link Genai.Retriever} that is configured
for the engine, then will issue the query to the LLM along with the similar passages for context, then will
post-process the result.

To be able to serve queries with relatively low latency (under 10 seconds), all datasets must be downloaded and
and models loaded into memory before the query is received. To make that possible, the Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine
is an {@link Engine}, meaning that it has a persistent Python process in which it can maintain global state (the
loaded models) between serving users' queries.
